tasks.label: Setup: dependencies, translations, database
tasks.detail: Run after cloning or pulling: creates .env, syncs uv, installs hooks and Chromium, compiles translations, migrates
tasks.command: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; uv sync && uv run pre-commit install && uv run playwright install chromium && cd src && uv run manage.py compilemessages && uv run manage.py migrate

tasks.label: Redis
tasks.detail: Starts an in-memory Redis on :6379 unless one is already running
tasks.command: redis-cli ping >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Redis is already running' || exec redis-server --save '' --appendonly no

tasks.label: Run app: web + worker
tasks.detail: The Procfile's web and worker via honcho, on http://localhost:8000 (run "Tailwind: watch" too when changing styles)

tasks.label: Tailwind: watch
tasks.detail: NODE_PATH lets an npm-installed CLI resolve @import "tailwindcss"; the standalone binary ignores it

tasks.label: Tests: full suite (same as CI)
tasks.command: uv run manage.py test app users integrations lists events api --parallel
